primaryTextChecks.text: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Outlaws joined up with Jephthah, and they went out with him.
When the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob.

contextChecks.before: Gilead’s wife bore him sons. When his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to him, “You will not inherit in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman.”
contextChecks.after: After a while, the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

contextChecks.before: After a while, the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
contextChecks.after: They said to Jephthah, “Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.”
